info.name: Webex Admin Address Book BroadWorks Enterprises API

params.name: spEnterpriseId
params.description: The Service Provider supplied unique identifier for the subscriber's enterprise.

params.name: startsWith
params.description: The starting string of the enterprise identifiers to match against.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of enterprises returned in the search, up to 1000.

items.docs: List the provisioned enterprises for a Service Provider. This API also lets a Service Provider search for their provisioned enterprises on Webex. A search on enterprises can be performed by either a full or partial enterprise identifier.

info.name: Get Directory Sync Status for an Enterprise

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the enterprise in question.

items.docs: This API lets a Partner Admin get the most recent directory sync status for a customer's Broadworks enterprise on Webex.

info.name: Trigger Directory Sync for an Enterprise

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the enterprise in question.

items.docs: This API lets a Partner Admin trigger a directory sync for the customer's Broadworks enterprise on Webex.

info.name: Update Directory Sync for a BroadWorks Enterprise

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the enterprise in question.

items.docs: This API lets a Partner Admin enable or disable directory sync for the customer's Broadworks enterprise on Webex.

info.name: Trigger Directory Sync for a User

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the enterprise in question.

items.docs: This API lets a Partner Admin trigger a directory sync for an external user (real or virtual user) on Broadworks enterprise with Webex.
